structuredContent.body:
Selected CI suites must end attachments before owned resources stop and must
clean up after success, failure, cancellation and partial startup. Persist an
exact preallocation owner receipt, allow only same-job CI attachment admission,
withdraw durably before stopping, and disable CI failure retention. The helper
forwards constructor-time cancellation and verifies exact receipt-bound cleanup;
own CI and release checks exercise it without activating the shared domain
workflow.

The packaged EventStore host skipped HTTP security and route-catalog setup that
SDK 3.129.0 already provides. Enroll the package host in those published
boundaries. The real archive probe supplies its own temporary app-channel token
and requires valid discovery plus missing/wrong credential refusals, while
retaining the existing subscription, receiver metadata and archive identity
assertions.

Validation: Release compilation with zero warnings/errors; 238
lifecycle/admission/engine/regression controls; 15 helper controls; self-CI
truth-table checks; publisher contract mutations; real packaged seed discovery
in configured and declarative modes, actor discovery 200 and credential refusals
401. Exact committed source/archive/proof hashes are retained in Platform Story
2.8 release evidence.

Dependency boundary: existing published EventStore 3.129.0 remains selected. No
dependency on the unpublished stream-reader SDK, family pin change, shared
domain-ci activation, caller enrollment or hosted candidate acceptance is
included. Merge and publication remain a separate approved stage.
